bad_account_id: Invalid Account ID: use 32 hexadecimal characters.
bad_type: Send OGG/Opus, WebM or MP4/M4A audio.
cannot_list_accounts: Could not list the accounts with this token. Check the token; if it is valid, add the Account → Account Settings → Read permission or enter the Account ID.
cf_timeout: Cloudflare took too long to answer.
check_permissions: Check the token, the account and the Workers AI permissions.
list_accounts_failed: Cloudflare could not list the accounts.
new_account_token: When changing the account, also enter the new account's token.
no_accounts: The token does not see any account. Enter the Account ID manually.
no_audio: The browser delivered the recording without audio ({kind}, {size} bytes). Try again holding a bit longer; if it happens again, reload the page.
no_speech: Could not detect speech in the audio ({info}).
no_transcription: The Cloudflare response did not include the transcription.
not_configured: Set the Cloudflare Account ID and token.
process_failed: Cloudflare could not process the audio (HTTP {status}{errors}; {info}).
rate_limited: Cloudflare usage limit reached. Try later.
token_invalid: Invalid token for this account. Check the token and the Account ID.
token_old_format: Paste the Cloudflare token again in the settings (old format).
too_large: The audio exceeds the allowed size.
transcription_timeout: The transcription took too long. Try again.
verify_failed: Cloudflare could not verify the token.
